scope.flow: TokenWrapper.transferFrom emits a Transfer event with the wrong from field

statements.text: A spender calls TokenWrapper.transferFrom, supplying an approved token owner as the from parameter.
The Transfer event emitted by transferFrom must identify in its from field the token holder whose balance decreases (the approved token owner), not the spender.
TokenWrapper.transferFrom emits the spender (msg.sender) as the from field of the Transfer event instead of the approved token owner (from parameter).
ERC-20 non-compliance – automated tooling may treat the token as invalid or malfunction when reconstructing balances from events.
Incorrect attribution – wallets, indexers, subgraphs, analytics and airdrop scripts will record the spender as the debited account, corrupting historical data, balances, and accounting.
Operational risk – once deployed, the incorrect events are immutable; integrators must add special-case logic or accept corrupted data.

ambiguities: Report does not state whether the spender is authorized or the allowance amount; only the from-field mismatch is described.
No explicit numeric values or bounds are given for the event fields.
